ValidationRule.description: A child project's code year may not precede its parent's, and it cannot reuse the parent's code (VLOOKUP on the parent project's Name).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Parent_Name_Ref__c)), REGEX(Code__c, 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), REGEX(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Code__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Parent_Name_Ref__c), 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}'), OR( VALUE(MID(VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Code__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Parent_Name_Ref__c), 5, 4)) > VALUE(MID(Code__c, 5, 4)), VLOOKUP($ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Code__c, $ObjectType.Project__c.Fields.Name, Parent_Name_Ref__c) = Code__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Child project code must not predate or equal its parent's code.
